metadata.name: GACP Brand Identity — Finance & Document System
metadata.owner: Tanai Digital Platform / Predictive AI Solution Co., Ltd.

supersedes.reason: B21-A's tokens copied FlowAccount.com trade dress (corner-triangle accents, purple=invoice / orange=quote / green=receipt color-per-document mapping). The new identity removes both signals and replaces them with an original Thai-government + medicinal-plant + DTAM-authority brand language.

metadata.principle: ม.86 ป.รัษฎากร — one document, one issuer. Color codes the document role; the role is also redundantly stated in the title text for color-blind accessibility (WCAG 1.4.1).
metadata.purpose: Canonical color, typography, layout and component tokens for the company's financial PDF templates — the three finance documents (quotation, invoice = ใบวางบิล / ใบแจ้งหนี้, and ONE paper for ใบเสร็จรับเงิน / ใบกำกับภาษีเต็มรูป = receipt-tax-invoice.html) plus the credit and debit notes — and the /provider/accounting/* dashboard. One issuer; no document in the ministry's name.
metadata.consumer: Templates and React components must read tokens from this file. Do not duplicate hex codes inline.

identitySignature.description: GACP's distinctive visual signal — used in place of FlowAccount's top-right corner triangle.

leftEdgeStripe.rationale: A left-edge vertical stripe is a generic editorial / report device used widely in government and academic publishing. It is visually distinct from FlowAccount's top-right diagonal triangle, easy to render with pure CSS (no clip-path, no SVG), and reads as 'official Thai document' rather than 'SME accounting SaaS'.

leafMark.description: Subtle medicinal-leaf glyph in the issuer header. Optional asset, not load-bearing.
leafMark.rationale: Reflects GACP context (medicinal-plant certification, ก.ม.พ. — กรมการแพทย์แผนไทยและการแพทย์ทางเลือก).

removedElements: .corner-accent (triangular clip-path top-right) — REMOVED across all 7 templates
Per-doc colors matching FlowAccount (purple=invoice, orange=quote, green=receipt) — REPLACED
Centered logo motif inside signature block — NOT USED (signature row uses plain divider)

typography.rationale: Sarabun is the Thai government open-source standard (license: SIL OFL). Typography is industry-standard for Thai accounting documents and is not subject to trade-dress protection.

margins.note: Left margin reserves 12mm for the identity stripe + 10mm whitespace gutter; right margin reduced 2mm because the corner-triangle is gone.

neutral.rationale: Cool-slate neutrals avoid the warm-gray tone used on FlowAccount.com and pair cleanly with the medicinal-green / earthy palette below.

INVOICE.thaiName: ใบวางบิล/ใบแจ้งหนี้
INVOICE.lawReference: ม.86 ป.รัษฎากร
INVOICE.chipLabel: ใบแจ้งหนี้
INVOICE.rationale: Forest green — GACP = good agricultural and collection practices for medicinal plants. Green is the literal subject matter, not a copied SaaS choice.

QUOTATION.thaiName: ใบเสนอราคา
QUOTATION.chipLabel: ใบเสนอราคา
QUOTATION.rationale: Warm earth amber — preliminary, welcoming, evokes rice-field / dried-herb tones. Different hue from FlowAccount's saturated orange (#EA580C) and used in a different role (Quotation, not their orange-coded document).

RECEIPT_TAX_INVOICE.thaiName: ใบเสร็จรับเงิน / ใบกำกับภาษีเต็มรูป
RECEIPT_TAX_INVOICE.lawReference: ม.86/4 ป.รัษฎากร
RECEIPT_TAX_INVOICE.rationale: One paper for the third finance document (operator-approved design docs/design/2026-09-05-finance-documents-design.md §1 row 3, §3.3): proof of payment and the full tax invoice together. Deep teal — settled, finalized payment.

CREDIT_NOTE.lawReference: ม.86/10 ป.รัษฎากร
CREDIT_NOTE.rationale: Burgundy rose — reduction event, somber but not alarming. Distinct from FlowAccount's bright red-600; the deeper rose-700 communicates 'careful adjustment' rather than 'error'.

DEBIT_NOTE.thaiName: ใบเพิ่มหนี้
DEBIT_NOTE.lawReference: ม.86/9 ป.รัษฎากร
DEBIT_NOTE.chipLabel: ใบเพิ่มหนี้
DEBIT_NOTE.rationale: Navy blue-900 — additional charge, formal, paired with credit-note rose as a clear positive/negative pair. Darker than FlowAccount's blue-600.

PENDING.label: รอดำเนินการ

AWAITING_PAYMENT.label: รอเก็บเงิน

NOT_YET_DUE.label: ยังไม่ครบกำหนด

OVER_90.label: ค้างเกิน 90 วัน

columnsInvoiceStyle.thaiHeader: ราคาต่อหน่วย

headerStyle.rationale: Soft-fill header with same-hue text — a different table-header treatment than FlowAccount's solid-color reversed-text header. Reads as 'editorial table' instead of 'SaaS dashboard table'.

grandTotalRow.rationale: Underline + soft tint instead of FlowAccount's solid-fill totals row. Cleaner for print.

watermark.note: Used for COPY / DRAFT / VOID overlays only — not a brand element.

signatureBlock.rationale: DELIBERATELY no centered-logo motif between the two signers — FlowAccount uses a centered company-logo decoration between the seller/receiver signature lines as a brand identifier. We use a plain divider (or nothing) to avoid that distinctive pattern.

icons.note: Tabler is MIT-licensed, no trade-dress overlap.

filterChip.rationale: Square-corner-rounded (8px) chips instead of the 9999px pill — visually different from FlowAccount's fully-rounded dashboard chips.

summaryCard.rationale: Left-border accent on cards echoes the document left-edge stripe — that becomes GACP's repeatable identity device across PDF + dashboard.

radii.note: Default cards use 10px (not 16px). FlowAccount uses generously rounded 16px cards as part of their SaaS-modern look; the 10px radius is a different feel — more 'government document' than 'consumer SaaS'.

implementationContract.loadOrder: Templates import this file via the PDF render service helper `resolveBrandTokens(docType)` which returns the documentType subtree merged with neutral, page, typography, itemsTable, totalsBlock, signatureBlock and identitySignature.
